messages.S1でわざとマッチに負けて精神力を一気に下げ、低い精神力で主力のS2「泥濘踏み」: A negative-Coin Identity that deliberately loses clashes with S1 to rapidly lower SP, then uses the main S2 Puddle Stomp at low SP to deal heavy damage while consuming Sinking.
messages.マッチ敗北で精神力が減る: この人格には特殊精神力増減「精神力減少」がある。マッ: **SP drops on Clash Lose**: This Identity has a special SP rule, SP Decrease. He loses SP on Clash Lose (10 by default, more for each Clash exchange after the first). S1 Umbrella Thwack has a low Clash Power of −1–5 (0–6 at higher Uptie) and grants 3 Sinking on [Clash Lose], making it a skill for losing to lower his SP.
messages.S2「泥濘踏み」が主力: 精神力-15未満で最終威力+2(低い同期化段階)/+3: **S2 Puddle Stomp is his main skill**: +2 Final Power below −15 SP (lower Uptie) or +3 (higher Uptie), and +2 more below −25. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ inflict Rupture on Tails Hit, and Coin Ⅳ spends 5 of his own Sinking for +20% damage (triggers Tremor Burst on Tails Hit). Because it reduces Sinking, it also keeps his SP from dropping too far.
messages.バトルパッシブ「泪の雨」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時に沈潜回: **Combat passive — Rain of Tears (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, spends 1 Sinking Count and lowers his own SP by his Sinking. Before taking damage, he gains Protection equal to his Sinking, up to 5 per turn. When taking damage, he gains 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn, up to 3 per turn. The effect is large with his Blunt S2.
messages.沈潜を自分に積む: S1は使用時に沈潜回数+1。S3「拡がれ！」は使用時に沈潜6: **Stacking Sinking on himself**: S1 adds +1 Sinking Count on use. S3 Spread Out! grants 6 Sinking and +3 Sinking Count on use. The Defense skill Warning grants 3/5 Sinking on use.
messages.減算コイン: 基本威力が高く、表面が出るたびに威力が下がる。裏面的中時の効果が多: **Minus Coins**: His Base Power is high, and power drops each time a Coin lands Heads. Many effects trigger on Tails Hit, and lower SP makes Tails more likely (a general game rule).
messages.序盤はS1でマッチに負けるか、S3で沈潜を得て精神力を下げる。精神力が十分下がっ: Early on, lose Clashes with S1 or gain Sinking with S3 to lower his SP. Once his SP is low enough, switch to attacking with S2. S2 consumes Sinking, so firing it just before E.G.O Corrosion prevents his SP from dropping too far. The design assumes the passive's Protection and Blunt DMG Up, so gather 3 Envy as early as possible (within 1–2 turns). The Defense skill Warning has low Coin Power and is worse than S1 for lowering SP. He is also easier to handle in Focused Encounters, where the opponent will attack him.
